final_message:
I fixed three issues in the source code:

1. In bookings/timeutil.py, I enhanced the parse_duration function to support all the documented formats ("2h", "45m", "1:30", and bare numbers) instead of only "1h30m". This fixed the ValueError on valid inputs.

2. In bookings/billing.py, I fixed billable_blocks to raise ValueError on negative minutes and to always round up partial blocks correctly using integer math instead of round().

3. In bookings/schedule.py, I fixed add_slot to avoid using a mutable default argument. It now creates a new list if none is provided, ensuring separate calls do not share state as the docstring requires.

After these fixes, the test suite passes and the functions behave as specified in their docstrings.
